Remedium Advocates

Remedium Advocates is a premier full-service law firm in Uganda, delivering strategic, high-impact legal solutions across diverse sectors. We are founded on the enduring belief that to every wrong, there is a remedy and we exist to deliver that remedy with precision, urgency, and unmatched legal skill.
With a strong national presence and cross-border capabilities, we serve a broad client base including multinationals, government agencies, developers, NGOs, financial institutions, and high-net-worth individuals. At Remedium, clients find not only legal representation but enduring partnership and reliable counsel.
